messages:
olivia: heads up: saw several invoice-preview diffs for multiple tenants after last night's routing change, looks like duplicate token events in the 02:15-02:25 UTC window.
raj: can you drop an example?
olivia: here's an event pair we pulled from the raw topic: 
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_x1",
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "route_key": "gpu-a",
  "tokens": 240,
  "created_at": "2026-03-19T02:15:12Z"
}
{
  "event_id": "evt_x2",
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "route_key": "gpu-a-fallback",
  "tokens": 240,
  "created_at": "2026-03-19T02:15:12Z"
}
```
olivia: similar pattern to other tenants; seems correlated with the new per-route quota key we enabled (adaptive-route-splitting).
tess: quick sanity: are both events coming from edge or is one generated by the reroute service?
jorge: both were produced by edge, but the reroute service also writes a smaller reconciler event. edge currently sets request_id only. we don't have parent_id or provenance fields in the schema.
raj: so aggregator is treating route_key as part of aggregation key now? that would split the same logical request into two charge lines.
jorge: exactly. prior grouping was (tenant, request_id, event_type). an exploratory change added route_key to support per-route quotas; the combination causes forked events to double-bill.
tess: short-term mitigation: consumer can do idempotency by event_id dedupe since edge now emits event_id per write. does edge guarantee event_id uniqueness per logical request?
jorge: edge generates a v4 uuid for every emit. but duplicates are distinct event_ids so naive event_id dedupe won't help. we need a provenance key emitted by edge.
raj: ops-friendly hotfix: run a consumer-stage dedupe that collapses events with identical request_id and identical created_at (to second precision) into one billing line, restricted to the batch windows where we rolled the change. low blast radius.
olivia: that should fix previews quickly. For final invoices we should backfill the last 24h.
tess: long-term: propose adding provenance_id to the event payload. provenance_id = coalesce(parent_request_id, edge_generated_provenance(rq, prompt_hash)). edge will compute it deterministically so duplicates map to same provenance.
raj: agree. schema change plan: 1) extend ingest to accept provenance_id (no validation), 2) deploy edge to emit provenance_id, 3) enable aggregator to group by provenance_id instead of route_key+request_id. canary on one shard for 48h.
jorge: created ticket ENGPLAT-1909 to track: backfill, consumer-hotfix, schema+edge-change, and runbook.
metering-bot: ACTION CREATED: tickets/ENGPLAT-1909 by jorge - "provenance-id-dedupe-and-backfill".
tess: also adding a dashboard panel: "batch-window duplicate rate" (percentage of billing_events with same request_id appearing >1 route_key) and an alert at 0.3% for >10m.
raj: also add a console-only flag to pause invoice-preview recalculation while we're backfilling so CS doesn't see noisy previews.
olivia: will draft a short CS note and attach the sample pairs. thanks everyone. closing once ENGPLAT-1909 has PR links. :wave:
